tools.next_step: Add bounded recurring-event previews without inventing posting dates.

tools.name: Field Hours Review
tools.description: Review draft clock-time shift minutes with explicit overnight choice. Unfinished source, not payroll or employer approval.
tools.requirements: Modern browser; open tool.html locally. Node.js 18+ optional for tests.
tools.limits: No dates, time zones or daylight-saving adjustment. Maximum 18-hour shift; whole unpaid lunch minutes. No overtime entitlement, paid-break or employer-submission logic.
tools.verification: 13 standalone Node VM/DOM-stub checks passed. Private opener integration not bundled/tested; browser/mobile acceptance not established.
tools.known_failures_scope: No failing check in named local suite; unsupported cases are in limits. Not a no-bugs claim.
tools.next_step: Add an explicit date/timezone mode with daylight-saving fixtures.

tools.name: Grocery Planning Preview
tools.description: Estimate a grocery basket from supplied recipes, plan, pantry and package offers. Unfinished source; missing prices remain unknown, not zero.
tools.requirements: Python 3.9+ standard library. Run python3 tool.py example.json. Required recipes/plan/pantry/offers lists and budget_cad; fictional example included.
tools.limits: No live prices, shopping integration, nutrition/allergy assessment or mixed-pack optimization. CLI: 1 MiB UTF-8, depth 32; 100 recipes/plan rows, 100 ingredients/recipe, 1,000 pantry/offers.
tools.verification: 17 functional +9 boundary/recovery checks passed. Not a production/device capacity guarantee or independent security audit.
tools.known_failures_scope: No failing check in named local suite; unsupported cases are in limits. Not a no-bugs claim.
tools.next_step: Add bounded mixed-pack optimization with a counterexample fixture.
tools.contribution_status: MIT fork and patch handoff; upstream PR allowlist unchanged

tools.name: Documented Compensation Comparison
tools.description: Evaluate documented-input hourly cash scenarios, explicit overtime evidence, commute costs and dues. Complete scenarios are not verified offers.
tools.requirements: Python 3.9+ standard library. Unzip; run python3 tool.py --input example.json.
tools.limits: CAD/hourly only; no salary, tax, noncash benefits or automatic evidence checks. CLI: 8 MiB UTF-8, 10,000 offers, 64 nesting levels; 1,024-character names/source refs. Duplicate JSON keys rejected. Limits are not a device-capacity guarantee.
tools.verification: 34 functional/boundary and 5 CLI retry checks passed. Explicit oversize/deep-input rejection, stable retries and unchanged inputs tested. ZIP bytes/member hashes verified. No independent security/production-capacity claim.
tools.next_step: Add an explicitly separate annual-salary input type without guessing benefits or entitlements.

tools.name: Invoice Reference Review
tools.description: Compare invoice references and payment rows, surfacing ambiguous, missing, duplicate, partial and orphan candidates. No accounting writes.
tools.requirements: Modern browser; optional Node.js 18+ for tests. Unzip and open tool.html locally. Invoice CSV requires invoice_id,amount with real known positive amounts. References alone do not fit. With no payment rows, paste the header invoice_id,amount,payment_id rather than blank text.
tools.limits: Strict quoted CSV; positive single-currency amounts; no refunds/credits/FX or authenticated matching. Maximum 1 MiB UTF-8 and 10,000 data rows per CSV. Version 0.1.1 had malformed-quote/byte-cap defects; do not rely on its matching output.
tools.verification: 15 original plus 15 bundled stress checks passed. Strict quotes and actual UTF-8 byte cap repaired. Public ZIP bytes and all member hashes independently read back. Standalone browser/device acceptance remains unverified; no outsider adoption claimed.
tools.next_step: Add separately tested credits/refunds without treating candidates as verified postings.

tools.name: Pretax Role Comparison
tools.description: Compare two hourly or salary cash scenarios and commute costs without treating unknown terms as zero. Before tax only.
tools.requirements: Modern browser; optional Node.js 18+ for tests. Unzip and open tool.html locally.
tools.limits: CAD-labelled planning only; no tax, pension, benefits, verified offers or employment advice. Non-finite scenario values or comparison differences return UNKNOWN. Paid and commute weeks share an input.
tools.verification: 12 engine and 4 actual-handler stub checks passed, including explicit overflow errors and invalid-to-valid retries. ZIP bytes/member hashes verified. No rendered browser/device or outsider-adoption claim.
tools.next_step: Separate paid weeks from commute weeks with backward-compatible tests.
